title: Rift Race
wikitext:
The '''Rift Race''' is a race located in the {{zone|West Village}}. The player must run over {{Green|10}} checkpoints, marked on the ground as gold pressure plates in the time frame given.

== Trivia ==
* Canceling the '''Rift Race''' fully replenishes the player's {{Stat|Mana}}.

== Tips ==
* Try to cut corners as much as possible.
* Use an {{Item|Aspect of the Leech}} to easily get across gaps that would be hard to jump across.
* Getting within {{Green|1}} block of a checkpoint counts as touching it.
